$comment: Caret context and insertion wrapping, one table driving three consumers: the bridge's Rust tests (crates/bridge/tests/caret_context.rs), the Mac's Swift tests (apps/mac/Tests/FlashTeXMacTests/CaretContextTests.swift) and the pdflatex oracle (scripts/caret_context_oracle.py). See protocol/proposals/transfer-v1-caret-context.md.

cases.name: text-paragraph-start-wraps-display
cases.why: A formula recognised on its own line becomes display math.

cases.name: text-paragraph-start-bare-math-gets-wrapped
cases.why: The model returned bare LaTeX; the insertion still has to wrap it.

cases.name: text-mid-sentence-bare-math-wraps-inline
cases.why: Mid-sentence the same bare formula must be inline, not display.

cases.name: inline-math-caret-strips-double-dollar-wrap
cases.why: THE double-wrap bug: $x^2$ inserted inside $...$ is a pdflatex error.

cases.name: inline-math-caret-strips-paren-wrap
cases.why: \(...\) inside $...$ is the same error in a different spelling.

cases.name: inline-math-caret-bare-math-untouched
cases.why: Already correct: nothing added, nothing stripped.

cases.name: display-math-caret-strips-display-wrap
cases.why: \[...\] nested in \[...\] is a pdflatex error.

cases.name: equation-environment-caret-strips-wrap
cases.why: Display math inside \begin{equation} is the same error.

cases.name: tabular-cell-never-takes-display-math
cases.why: \[...\] in a tabular cell is a pdflatex error; a cell takes inline math only.
advisories: AMBIGUOUS: display math is not allowed in a tabular cell; inserted as inline math

cases.name: tabular-cell-bare-math-wraps-inline
cases.why: Bare math in a cell still has to be wrapped, and inline is the only legal choice.

cases.name: verbatim-inserts-literally
cases.why: Inside verbatim nothing is LaTeX; wrapping would print the delimiters.
advisories: AMBIGUOUS: the destination is a verbatim block; the transcription was inserted literally and is not typeset as LaTeX

cases.name: comment-inserts-literally-single-line
cases.why: A caret in a % comment must not gain delimiters, and must not gain a newline.
advisories: AMBIGUOUS: the destination is a comment; the transcription was inserted literally and is not typeset

cases.name: prose-at-math-caret-uses-mbox-without-amsmath
cases.why: Prose recognised inside math needs a text box; \text needs amsmath, \mbox is kernel.
advisories: AMBIGUOUS: prose recognised at a math caret was wrapped in \mbox{...}

cases.name: prose-at-math-caret-uses-text-with-amsmath
cases.why: With amsmath loaded \text is the idiomatic and correctly-spaced choice.
advisories: AMBIGUOUS: prose recognised at a math caret was wrapped in \text{...}

cases.name: unbalanced-delimiters-are-refused
cases.why: Never insert LaTeX that cannot close; refusal beats a broken document.
advisories: UNSUPPORTED: the proposal's math delimiters are unbalanced and it cannot be inserted safely

cases.name: mixed-prose-and-math-at-text-caret-is-untouched
cases.why: A transcribed paragraph that already wraps its own formulas is left exactly as it is.
cases.proposal: The identity $a^2 = b$ follows, and therefore \[ c = d \] holds.
cases.insert: The identity $a^2 = b$ follows, and therefore \[ c = d \] holds.

cases.name: mixed-prose-and-math-at-math-caret-is-refused
cases.why: Text-mode content with interior delimiters cannot be made safe inside math.
advisories: UNSUPPORTED: text-mode content with its own math delimiters cannot be inserted at a math caret

cases.name: escaped-dollar-is-not-a-math-delimiter
cases.why: \$ is a literal dollar sign; the caret after it is still in text mode.

cases.name: dollar-inside-a-comment-does-not-open-math
cases.why: A stray $ in a comment must not make the whole rest of the file look like math.

cases.name: dollar-inside-verbatim-does-not-open-math
cases.why: Verbatim bodies are not scanned for delimiters; the caret after the block is text.

cases.name: nested-math-environment-keeps-math-mode
cases.why: aligned inside equation is depth 2; the caret is still math, not text.

cases.name: after-a-closed-math-environment-the-caret-is-text
cases.why: The nesting counter must come back down; this is the bug depth tracking fixed.
